title: Corpus-scale O++ conjunction classification and PNG raster suite export
notes: Evaluated all 8,597 units for O++ conjunction criteria: (1) Omission Rate > Intact Control Rate AND (2) Omission Rate > P1-D1 Stimulus Presentation Rate.
Identified 1,144 O++ conjunction units across the corpus.
Rendered 300 DPI PNG raster suite figures for top O++ units in outputs/raster_suites/oplusplus/.
